title: terragucci.report-index/v1
description: A reports bucket's index.json: one row per run, newest first. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

reports.description: Newest first: up to 500 rows, then the newest row of each project, stage and wave beyond them.

wave.description: The wave of a tf-apply run.

share.description: The share of a tf-apply wave split across jobs.

path.description: The run's directory, relative to this index: <yyyy>/<mm>/<commit>/<stage>[-wave-N[-share-S]] in a project's index, prefixed with the project in the top index.

failed.description: Roots that failed to plan or apply. Absent on rows written before it was kept.

changed.description: Roots with at least one change; on a tf-drift row, the roots that drifted.

waiting_since.description: When a waiting wave began waiting for an approval of its digest.

applied.description: When a tf-apply wave finished applying.

overridden.description: Roots the policy denied that a recorded override let through. Absent when none.

destroys.description: Destroys and replacements as `<root>: <address>`, at most 50.

destroys_total.description: How many destroys and replacements there are, when there are more than the row lists.
